notablePrerequisites:
Multani's Harmony attached to Battered Golem.
Battered Golem does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Lonis.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating a Clue token.
The Clue enters the battlefield, triggering Battered Golem, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.
